tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.cru: Ore broken into small pieces. Wash it, sort it or leach it next.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.pur: Crushed ore with the dirt washed off. Ready to smelt.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.mat: Fine powder of the metal. Smelt it or use it as feed for special machines.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.hea: Ore with most of the rock removed. Smelt it or melt it in a blast furnace.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.lig: Waste rock that floated away. Crush it again for a little dust.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.min: Metal-rich foam skimmed off a flotation tank. Smelt it or melt it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.spe: Leftover slurry after flotation. Crush it for a little dust.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.mag: The magnetic part of the ore, pulled out by a magnet. Smelt it or melt it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.non: The part the magnet left behind. Crush it for a little dust.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.cru: Rough metal from a furnace, still full of impurities. Refine it further or smelt it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.vit: Glassy waste that floats on molten metal. Crush it for a little dust.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.con: A cleaner metal bar with carbon and sulfur burned away.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.met: A porous lump of metal made without melting. Refine it or smelt it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.rec: Salt left over from the retort. A salt electrolyzer can turn it back into metal.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.lea: Metal dissolved in acid. Extract it or make it solid again.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.fil: Wet solid waste left after leaching. Crush it for a little dust.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.org: Metal pulled out of the acid into oil. Make it solid to get the metal.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.str: Acid with the metal removed. Waste.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.sol: Solid metal salt that settled out of a solution. Smelt it or electrolyze it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.cat: A very pure metal plate grown by electricity.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.ano: Muddy leftovers from electrorefining, rich in precious metals. Smelt it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.deg: Metal with trapped gases removed, which makes it stronger.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.mod: Tiny waste particles drawn out of the metal. Waste.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.arc: Top grade metal with no flaws.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.lig: A light fuel split off by the column. Burn it in any machine.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.hea: A heavy fuel split off by the column. Burn it in any machine.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.vap: Ultra pure metal deposited from a vapor.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.pol: A rod of very pure material made of many small crystals. Smelt it or grow one big crystal from it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.cry: The impure ends cut off a crystal. Waste.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.sin: Powder pressed and baked into one hard block.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.enr: Material sorted into a more potent form. Reprocess it in a hot cell or smelt it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.dep: What is left after enrichment. Reprocess it or crush it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.stage.vit: Dangerous waste locked inside glass. Crush it for a little dust.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.d: A heavy powder mixed into water so that only the heaviest ore sinks.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.f: An oily chemical that makes metal grains stick to bubbles.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.s: Limestone powder that binds impurities into slag.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.c: Baked coal. Burns hotter and longer than coal.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.l: Strong acid that dissolves metal out of crushed ore.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.o: An oil that pulls metal out of acid.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.p: A chemical that makes dissolved metal turn solid again.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.r: A reactive metal powder that steals oxygen away from metal.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.i: A gas that does not react, used to protect hot metal from air.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.p: A reactive gas used for burning out impurities, vaporizing and enrichment.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.reagent.s: A tiny crystal that a large one grows from. Rarely used up.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.o: Breaks ore into Crushed Ore. It also recycles waste into a little dust.
Washes Crushed Ore with water to make Purified Ore.
Melts refined material into ingots or gems.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.d: Sorts crushed ore by weight. Heavy metal sinks and is kept, light rock floats off as waste.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.f: Uses bubbles to lift metal sulfide grains to the top and leave the rock behind.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.m: Uses a strong magnet to pull magnetic metal out of crushed ore.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.b: Burns fuel to strip oxygen from ore and melt the metal out. Also makes slag.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.o: Blasts gas through crude metal to burn out carbon and sulfur.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.t: A sealed oven where a reactive metal pulls stubborn metals like titanium out of their ore.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.p: Dissolves metal out of crushed ore using hot acid under pressure.
Mixes the acid solution with oil so the metal moves into the oil.
Adds a chemical so dissolved metal turns back into a solid.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.e: Uses electricity to move pure metal onto a plate and leave impurities and precious metals behind.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.m: Uses electricity in molten salt to make reactive metals such as aluminum.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.v: Pulls trapped gas out of molten metal under vacuum to make stronger metal.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.a: Remelts metal slowly with an electric arc so it freezes without flaws.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.f: Heats a material and splits it into light and heavy fuels.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.v: Turns metal into a gas and deposits it again as ultra pure metal.
Grows very pure material from gas onto a hot surface.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.c: Slowly pulls one perfect crystal out of molten material.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.g: Presses and bakes powder at extreme heat into one hard block.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.c: Spins material very fast to sort heavy from light, which enriches it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.machine.h: A shielded chemistry room that reprocesses enriched material. Dangerous.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.waste: Waste. The Ore Crusher can recycle it.
tooltip.universaloreprocessing.fuel: Works as fuel in any machine.
gui.universaloreprocessing.status.reject: This item does not fit here. Accepted: %s
gui.universaloreprocessing.status.output: Output is full. Take the items out.
gui.universaloreprocessing.status.needs_: Needs water. Use a water bucket on the machine.
Out of fuel. Add coal or coke.
gui.universaloreprocessing.hint.fuel: Fuel: coal, charcoal, coke and more.
gui.universaloreprocessing.hint.reagent: Reagent: %s. A helper item that is used up.
guide.universaloreprocessing.intro.1: This mod turns ore into ingots in several steps. Each step has its own machine. More steps give more ingots from the same ore, plus useful by-products.
guide.universaloreprocessing.intro.2: You do not need every machine. Start with the Ore Crusher, the Ore Washer and the Ore Smelter. Add the others later, when you want more output or a specific metal.
guide.universaloreprocessing.intro.3: Every item remembers which metal it came from. Hold Shift over any item or machine to see what it is for.
guide.universaloreprocessing.basic.1: 1. Ore Crusher: put in any ore or raw metal. You get Crushed Ore.
guide.universaloreprocessing.basic.2: 2. Ore Washer: put in Crushed Ore and give the machine water, by using a water bucket on it. You get Purified Ore.
guide.universaloreprocessing.basic.3: 3. Ore Smelter: put in Purified Ore. You get the ingot or gem.
guide.universaloreprocessing.basic.4: Machines need fuel such as coal, or power if the pack uses it. Hoppers and pipes work: items go in from the top, come out of the bottom, and fuel goes in from the sides.
guide.universaloreprocessing.screen.1: Every machine screen has a status line at the top. It says what the machine is doing, or what is missing, for example Needs reagent: Leach Acid.
guide.universaloreprocessing.screen.2: Left: the input slot, and below it the reagent slot. Some machines use up a reagent, a helper item, on every job. Right: the main output and the waste output. Bottom middle: fuel.
guide.universaloreprocessing.screen.3: The side bars show fuel or power, and water. The emblem in the middle lights up while the machine works. Hover over anything for an explanation.
guide.universaloreprocessing.screen.4: Waste items can go into the Ore Crusher to get a little dust back.
guide.universaloreprocessing.materials.1: Not every metal fits every machine. Each metal has properties, such as heavy, sulfide or magnetic. Each machine only takes metals with a matching property.
guide.universaloreprocessing.materials.2: Use the command /uop stations followed by a metal name to see which machines take it.
guide.universaloreprocessing.materials.3: Pack makers can change the properties in the config.
guide.universaloreprocessing.reagents.in: Reagents are helper items. A machine needs the right one in its reagent slot. All of them can be crafted from ordinary items, so look them up in the recipe viewer.
guide.universaloreprocessing.locked.1: Machines above tier %s are switched off in this world. Raise max_tier in the config to unlock them.
guide.universaloreprocessing.locked.2: Higher tiers give more ingots per ore, but they need a lot more setup.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.1.name: Sorting
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.1.text: Sorting removes waste rock before melting, which saves fuel. Each machine sorts by a different property.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.2.name: Furnaces
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.2.text: Furnaces melt the metal out of the ore. They need fuel and usually a helper item.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.3.name: Chemistry
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.3.text: Chemistry dissolves metal in liquid and then pulls it back out. It works on ores that furnaces handle badly.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.4.name: Electricity
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.4.text: Electricity plates out very pure metal. These machines use a lot of power.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.5.name: Vacuum
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.5.text: Vacuum machines remove gas and flaws to make the strongest metal.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.6.name: Vapor
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.6.text: Vapor machines boil and condense materials to purify them.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.7.name: Crystals
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.7.text: Crystal machines grow flawless crystals for electronics.
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.8.name: Extreme
guide.universaloreprocessing.tier.8.text: The most extreme machines. Expensive, slow and dangerous.
